card.name: Linking words before vasopressor names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "as" or "requiring" right before a vasopressor or inotrope is named, in advice on treating low blood pressure or shock.

modes.label: Before a drug list
modes.description: "of" or "as" just before vasopressors such as dopamine or norepinephrine are named.
modes.example: consider intravenous administration<< of>> dopamine, dobutamine, isopro

modes.label: Severity grading
modes.description: Words in toxicity grading that lead into the need for vasopressors.

card.writes: Promotes odd non-English fragments and suppresses unrelated pieces, so there is no clear output effect.
